facts.fact: Minister Gungubele said the Ya Rona Digital Skills Massification Drive, run by the department with NEMISA, had been rolled out in North West, KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo and Free State, was under way in Eastern Cape, and had trained over 20,000 citizens in basic digital literacy.
